candidate_freeze: Record immutable model, encoder, feature/preprocessing contract, threshold and source-code SHA256 before any release scoring
Choose candidates and thresholds on training/development validation only

operational_policy.approval_evidence: Owner instructed implementation of the preceding local deployment plan on 2026-10-16.

holdout_requirements: Document historical source/capture timestamps per record; processing dates are not capture dates
Attach independent historical label evidence tied to every URL/capture and checksum-address the evidence manifest
Exclude all known training, validation, test and examined development URL/domain groups before scoring
Document unknown domains, unverified cross-domain campaigns, near-duplicate screenshots and acquisition exclusions
Retain source licenses/attribution; unresolved licenses prevent redistribution
Include both classes and source strata; describe deployment-prevalence limitations
registration: Freeze canonical manifest, image checksums if applicable, labels, domain/campaign grouping and evidence checksum before scoring
Register independent_evidence_sha256 and operator noninspection attestation with the existing holdout registry
Freeze approved policy SHA256, candidate hashes and protocol SHA256 before scoring
evaluation: Score once, retain negative and positive findings
Report PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, precision, recall, F1, confusion counts, false positives per10000 benign, Brier and ECE10
Report source/class/domain strata and95% domain-cluster bootstrap intervals with unknown campaign limitations
Measure warm/cold end-to-end latency on target worker hardware including validation, preprocessing and inference; extraction throughput is not request p95
Bind model, data, evidence, policy and contract hashes into an immutable release evaluation
Release gate: recall Wilson95 lower bound >=0.80 and FPR Wilson95 upper bound <=0.01 on each supported scoring path, with >=5000 benign and >=2000 independently supported phishing records.
Unavailable outputs remain in recall and coverage denominators; required coverage is 100 percent on registered supported-path inputs.
Warm model request p95 budgets: quick_url 2000ms, deep_url 15000ms; each inference task <=60000ms.
enrichment: Collect prospectively with timestamped requests and cache freshness; preserve null/unavailable and forbid label-feed membership predictors. Existing1000-domain retrospective observations stay diagnostic. No arbitrary24-hour wait is needed to prepare or register this protocol.
after_evaluation: Examined data becomes a declared development benchmark for later model decisions; obtain another untouched holdout for later release claims
activation: Owner has authorized implementation and local v10 actions conditional on independently verified release quality. A passing immutable evaluation and operational policy remain technical requirements; no additional repeated permission gate.
implementation: scripts/model_release_evaluation.py validates registration before opening predictions and refuses to overwrite output versions.
